open_points.subject: bootstrap_first_administrator
open_points.text: bootstrap_first_administrator: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST normalize the supplied email and validate the supplied password through the existing staff identity input boundary, hash that password exactly as supplied with hash_password of the credential boundary, build the account with the imported build_bootstrap_staff_account from the normalized email, that hash and the one utc_now instant, build its audit record with the imported build_bootstrap_audit_record from that same instant and the built account, and hand both to the port in one call.
open_points.other_text: bootstrap_first_administrator: [RETURN_SHAPE] MUST return the hash-free = models.StaffAccountView the imported build_staff_account_view builds from the account it handed to the port, so the password hash never leaves this module.
open_points.question: Either change the claim that the password hash never leaves this module, because the account built from that hash is handed to the port, or clarify that the intended guarantee is only that the hash does not enter the returned StaffAccountView.
